In December 2020, the Æternity proof of work network suffered a series of reported 51% attacks that targeted exchange deposits and attempted double spends. The publicly available record does not support the existing classification of a validator key compromise. Æternity stated that attackers temporarily controlled most network hash power, mined an alternative chain, and attempted to reverse exchange transactions involving roughly 29 million AE tokens. The incident was a reported majority hash power attack against the Æternity proof of work chain.
